## Gmail Invoices To WhatsApp Official

Reads unread invoice emails from Gmail using the official Gmail node, extracts invoice details, sends the summary and PDF attachment through Meta WhatsApp Cloud API, then marks the Gmail message as read.

Important: Meta WhatsApp Business API does not support WhatsApp groups. Use WHATSAPP_INVOICE_RECIPIENTS as a comma-separated list of finance/admin phone numbers.

No paid n8n Variables are required. Open the Workflow Config node and paste your values there.

Required config fields:
- META_WHATSAPP_ACCESS_TOKEN
- META_WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID
- META_GRAPH_API_VERSION, default v20.0
- WHATSAPP_INVOICE_RECIPIENTS, example: 9715xxxxxxxx,9715yyyyyyyy
- GMAIL_INVOICE_SEARCH_QUERY
- INVOICE_ALLOWED_SENDERS

Required credential:
- Gmail OAuth2 credential connected to the invoice mailbox.

filters.q: ={{$json.GMAIL_INVOICE_SEARCH_QUERY || 'is:unread has:attachment (from:taxinvoice@network.ae OR from:digital.services@taqadistribution.com OR from:etisalat OR from:eand OR from:bank)'}}

parameters.jsCode: return [{ json: { ...$json, body: { messaging_product: 'whatsapp', to: $json.recipient, type: 'text', text: { preview_url: false, body: $json.message } } } }];
